Background

About

"I build the kind of content that actually moves people — because I've lived the culture it comes from."

Charles Hailey is an Integrated Producer and social media strategist with 6+ years of agency experience at Day One Agency, Kettle, and Deutsch NY. He has brought campaigns to life for Nike, American Express, and Pacifico — leading production from concept to delivery across social, video, and live events.

He captures, creates, edits, and manages content end-to-end — from on-set production and raw footage to final delivery across every platform. Where brand strategy meets cultural authenticity, that's where he does his best work. He brings genuine insider perspective to every brief — and outside agencies, he runs Jersey Natives, an NJ-themed apparel brand built on the culture he grew up in.

Creative Direction

The Insight

"The mountain isn't the destination. It's the proof."

Snow League audiences aren't casual viewers — they're participants who've earned their peaks. Pacifico's "Discover More" platform fits that ethos perfectly.

Nike Kobe VIII — Concept Campaign · 2025

Silence.
Then Strike.

A full Black Mamba campaign concept — social rollout strategy, platform deliverables, VO script, merch line, and AI-generated key visual built around the Kobe VIII.

Project Type

Spec Campaign Concept

Scope

Strategy · Creative · VO · Merch

Platforms

IG · TikTok · X · Pinterest · YouTube · SNKRS

Key Visual

AI-Generated · Midjourney / Higgsfield

Objective

"Build a campaign worthy of the Mamba legacy — one that earns its reverence instead of demanding it, and treats the shoe as a cultural artifact rather than a product."

The Insight

Kobe didn't announce himself. He arrived.

The Black Mamba wasn't a persona Kobe performed — it was a philosophy he operated from. Silence was the strategy. The campaign concept takes that as its creative foundation: before you ever see the shoe, you feel the tension. The reveal earns its moment because the buildup respects the legend.

Campaign Architecture

Four phases. One arc.

01

Phase 01 · Days 1–3

The Coil

No product. No text. Snake imagery only. Teaser content drops at 3AM. Build dread and anticipation before anyone knows what's coming.

02

Phase 02 · Day 4

The Strike

Full key visual drops. Kobe VIII revealed. "Silence. Then Strike." copy lands. Hero video goes live at 8:24AM — Kobe's number, always.

03

Phase 03 · Days 5–10

The Legacy

UGC amplification, community tributes, merch drops, editorial storytelling, and collector community content sustain the moment.

04

Phase 04 · Day 11+

The Archive

"Where were you when Kobe wore the VIII?" Fan photo submissions and Mamba Mentality quote pairings keep the conversation alive long-tail.

Key Visual

The image is the campaign.

Built entirely with AI image generation. The Black Mamba coils around darkness, rain-soaked and patient. The shoe floats in gold light, reflected on wet surface below. "Silence. Then Strike." — the line writes itself once you see it.

Side Profile · 4:5

Heel and signature detail — editorial product photography.

Campaign Poster · 4:5

Secondary asset — Instagram feed and story cover.

Product Hero · 16:9

Floating profile — YouTube thumb, paid media, banner.

Color System

Four colors. One world.

The palette wasn't designed — it was excavated. Every color pulled directly from the mythology: the obsidian of the snake's scales, the gold of Kobe's signature Swoosh, the purple of 20 seasons at Staples, the dark wet surface he always performed on. Nothing was chosen for aesthetics alone. Everything means something.

Mamba Black

#050505

The void. The silence before the strike. Primary background for all campaign assets.

Gold Standard

#C9A84C

The Swoosh. The signature. The underglow on the wet court. Earned, not given.

Laker Purple

#4A1B8A

20 seasons. 5 rings. The heel detail that says everything without a word.

Wet Asphalt

#1A1A1A

The rain-soaked surface. The reflection. The atmosphere that makes everything feel inevitable.

Platform Deliverables

Six platforms. Every format.

01

Instagram

Feed · Reels · Stories · Collab

1:1 hero image, 4:5 lifestyle, 9:16 Reel, Story sequence with link sticker CTA. Collab post seeded with sneaker accounts.

02

TikTok

Teaser · Reveal · Tribute

:15 dark teaser (no product), :30 reveal cut, :60 tribute film. Trending audio hook pre-mapped for maximum early distribution.

03

Twitter / X

Thread · Quote Card · Countdown

Teaser tweet with zero image — copy only. 16:9 reveal card on drop day. Multi-post Mamba Mentality quote thread to sustain engagement.

04

Pinterest

Hero Pin · Editorial Board

2:3 hero pin, detail shots of sole and signature, full "Black Mamba" board with colorway breakdowns and archival context.

05

YouTube

Shorts · Hero Film

:60 Short (vertical), 2–3 min hero film with chapter timestamps. Thumbnail: hero key visual. VO narrated via ElevenLabs, original score via Suno.

06

SNKRS / Nike App

Drop Page · Push Notification

Product story module, launch graphic, countdown timer asset. Push notification copy: "The Mamba. The VIII. Now. 🐍" — under 60 characters.

Copy Hierarchy

Every word earns its place.

Headline

Product

Kobe VIII — Legend Never Dies

Teaser

Hashtag Strategy

#SilenceThenStrike #KobeVIII #MambaMentality #BlackMamba #LegendNeverDies #NikeBasketball #KobeBryant #Kobe24 #SNKRS

Merch — Apparel Line

The campaign wears itself.

Five tee designs generated to show how the Black Mamba aesthetic translates to wearable product. Each piece is a campaign artifact — not merch slapped with a logo, but clothing that carries the mythology. Black heavyweight cotton. Gold screenprint. Snake scale texture. Limited numbered runs.

Design 01

Legend Never Dies — Snake scale all-over texture. Gold foil block type. Folded flat.

Design 02

The Strike — Full back mamba mid-strike. Gold discharge on black. Front: nothing.

Design 03

Silence — Mamba coiled in basketball silhouette. Front/back shown.

Design 03 — Back

Silence back. "Not out of hesitation. Out of precision." Vertical gold type.

Design 04

8.24 — Snake eye halftone oversized on vintage wash. Just the numbers.

Design 05

Mamba Mentality — Kobe Sheath embroidered chest. Full VO manifesto on back. "KOBE VIII · BLACK MAMBA" hem.

Creative Direction

"The image is the strategy. Everything else is execution."

The key visual does the campaign's hardest work — it creates tension before the product reveal, establishes the Black Mamba mythology visually, and earns the emotional weight of "Legend Never Dies" without having to explain it. Built entirely with AI tools and directorial instinct, this is what happens when you treat technology as a brush, not a shortcut.

Native Energy — Original Concept Work

Charged From
The Source.

Full energy drink brand built from zero — can design, brand identity, color system, flavor line, and AI-generated product photography across multiple angles.

Brand
Native Energy
Type
Original Concept — Full Brand Build
Role
Brand Strategy · Creative Direction · AI Production
Output
Can Design · Brand Identity · Product Photography
The Brief

The energy drink market is saturated with brands that grew up in boardrooms. Native Energy is the answer to that — raw ingredients, original art, and a design that means something before you even read the label.

The Concept

Native means original. Not a geography — a standard.

Native Energy isn't named after a place. "Native" is a declaration — this drink is indigenous to itself. Original, uncut, exactly what it says it is. The lightning bolt and the feather tell the whole story: one is instant and electric, the other is ancient and earned. Together they define a brand that hits hard and means something.

Scope of Work

01
Brand Identity
Full Brand System — From Zero
Built the complete brand from scratch: name, positioning, color system, typography direction, brand voice, pillars, and tagline. "From the Source."
02
Can Design
Matte Black — Purple Lightning — Feather Art
Conceived and art-directed the can: matte black body, large purple lightning bolt graduating from deep indigo to electric lavender, eagle feather illustration with turquoise bead detail on the right panel.
03
AI Product Photography
Multi-Angle Campaign Shoot — AI Generated
Wrote and executed photorealistic AI product photography prompts across six hero angles: 3/4 front, flat front, low power shot, side feather detail, overhead flat lay, and dynamic lean — all on a locked wet volcanic basalt background.
04
Brand Strategy
Positioning · Voice · Go-To-Market
Wrote the full brand bible: consumer profile, brand pillars, voice guide, flavor line naming, and a three-phase underground-first go-to-market strategy.

Product Photography — AI Generated

Two hero angles. One locked world.

Both shots generated using Nano Banana with photorealistic product photography prompts. Wet volcanic basalt surface, purple rim lighting, ARRI Alexa color grade — every detail art-directed and locked before generation.

Hero — 3/4 Front View

Volcanic basalt surface · Purple rim light · Heavy condensation · 85mm f/2.8

Campaign Copy

The bolt isn't a logo. It's a warning. Native Energy — From the Source. ⚡ #NativeEnergy #ChargedFromTheSource #OriginalStorm

Low Angle — Power Shot

Camera at surface level · Can towers in frame · Pure dark atmosphere · 35mm f/5.6

Campaign Copy

Real ingredients don't need a legend. Native Energy — Charged from the source. Not the factory. ⚡ #NativeEnergy #FromTheSource

Brand System

Obsidian. Storm. Arc. Static.

The color system is built around one tension: darkness and voltage. Obsidian black as the base — the can absorbs light rather than reflects it. Purple as the only accent: Storm (#7B2FBE), Arc (#A855F7), Static (#C084FC). Three shades of the same electrical charge, used deliberately across the bolt, feather, and typography.

Creative Direction

The Design

"The bolt and the feather are the same idea stated twice."

The bolt is instant, kinetic, electric. The feather is ancient, precise, earned. Neither is decoration — they're the brand argument made visual. Matte black can, no shine, no apology. The can absorbs light the way the brand absorbs attention.

The Photography

"Looks like a $50k product shoot. Built in a prompt window."

Six hero angles written as full photorealistic briefs — surface, lighting, lens, depth of field, color grade all specified. Wet volcanic basalt, purple rim lighting, ARRI Alexa LF color science. The prompt is the art direction. The AI executes it.
